name: Monograph ~Tooi Yakusoku~
source:
Half-humans live in this world alongside humans. Main character has a lineage of both half-humans and famous exorcists. His older brother initially inherits family business, so protagonist moves to his relatives place to start his happy and slightly strange school life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这个世界中，半人种族与人类共同生活。主人公同时继承半人血统和著名驱魔师家系。哥哥最初继承了家业，因此主人公搬到亲戚家，开始幸福而略显奇异的校园生活。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
